sets.ref: hand: Fiore, AC Electrical Circuit Analysis section 9.3, example 9.3.3 (Y-Y, phase voltage 240 V, load 40 + j30 ohm = 50 ohm at cos phi 0.8, line current 4.8 A): U_LL = 240 x sqrt(3) = 415.692 V; S = sqrt(3) x 415.692 x 4.8 = 3456 VA = 3 x 240 x 4.8; P = 2764.8 W; Q = 2073.6 var (the book prints 3456 VA and 2765 W)

hand: Fiore section 9.3, example 9.3.5 (generator phase voltage 100 V, line voltage 173.205 V, delta load of 50 ohm per leg at cos phi 0.8, line current 6 A): S = sqrt(3) x 173.205 x 6 = 1800 VA; P = 1440 W (the book prints 1440 W); Q = 1080 var; load leg current 6 / sqrt(3) = 3.4641 A
